Raised 18,500 -> 22,500 B (P4-14 follow-up, complete Discord short-name table): the generator now merges Discord's own short names (xCykrix/discord_emoji, pinned by commit and SHA-256) ahead of each row's names, so the `:` popup picks the same first row Discord does (`:cry` is 😢, not 😂; `:sunglasses` is 😎, not 🕶️). forbidEmbeddedWasm.note: No emitted JS chunk may contain the base64 WASM magic. Generalises decision 10's forbidWasmInStartup: the RNNoise barrel regression (C-07) embeds 1.9 MB of sync WASM in whatever chunk pulls it, which is exactly this marker.
